title: The tensor product of the Fremlin tensor product of Banach lattice algebras
summary: We study the Arens regularity of the Fremlin projective tensor product of Banach lattice algebras. We firrst introduce and investigate L-weakly almost periodic functionals, a class of functionals defind in terms of L-weak compactness of their orbits. We obtain a characterization of these functionals in terms of bounded disjoint sequences and use it to analyze the Fremlin projective tensor product.
